account_custom_field_help.auth_type: basic or digest sends Username and Password of the account with every request. Empty sends no login, e.g. when the API wants a key in request_headers.
account_custom_field_help.cert: Path to a client certificate file on the Syncer server, for an API that wants one. Empty sends none.
account_custom_field_help.request_headers: HTTP headers of every request, as a Python dict. Example: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'my-api-key'}
account_custom_field_help.data_key: Key of the response that holds the list of records. Example: result for {"result": [...]}. Empty when the response is the list itself.
account_custom_field_help.method: GET or POST. POST sends post_body.
account_custom_field_help.post_body: Body of a POST request, JSON. Jinja is rendered first, so a loop over lookup_rows('table') can build a filter from a lookup table.
account_custom_field_help.page_limit: Records per request, sent as value of page_limit_field. Set it to read the API page by page: the Syncer asks again with a higher offset until a page brings fewer records than this. Empty reads everything with one request.
account_custom_field_help.page_offset_field: Name of the API parameter for the number of records to skip, used with page_limit. A GET sends it as URL parameter, a POST adds it to post_body. Default: offset
account_custom_field_help.page_limit_field: Name of the API parameter for the number of records per page, used with page_limit. Its value is page_limit. Default: limit
account_custom_field_help.hostname_field: Field of a record the host is named after. A record without it is skipped.
account_custom_field_help.rewrite_hostname: Jinja template that builds the hostname, with HOSTNAME as the value of hostname_field and every field of the record available. Example: {{ HOSTNAME | lower }}
account_custom_field_help.filter_field: Field of a record that is checked against filter_lookup_table. Only records whose value is in the first column of that table are imported, all others are skipped. Empty imports every record.
account_custom_field_help.filter_lookup_table: Name of the lookup table (Modules > Lookup Tables) used by filter_field. Its first column holds the allowed values, written exactly as the API delivers them. The import stops with an error when the table does not exist.
account_custom_field_help.path: Path to a JSON file on the Syncer server, read instead of calling the API. Empty calls the API.
